$comment: AI visual review (pnpm a11y:visual) — advisory: a person confirms findings and records the review with pnpm a11y:review.

answers.reason: All variants and states are identified by text labels ('neutral', 'warning', 'info', 'success', 'danger', etc.). Color reinforces but doesn't convey meaning alone.

Colored borders on variant chips are clearly visible; icons (checkmarks, X, clock, info) are distinguishable; focus rings are bright blue with strong contrast. Borderless chips in Dismissible story are identified by visible text.
All visible text on controls matches screen reader announcements. Dismiss buttons (×) are icon-only, so 2.5.3 doesn't apply.
No text is cut off, overlapping, or truncated in any story or theme.
All focused screenshots (Dismissible, Variants, With Icons) show a thick, bright blue focus ring that is obviously visible and contrasts well with backgrounds.
